name: TuneCraft: AI Music Generator
original_description:
Turn an idea, a moment, or a story into a song. Describe what you want to hear, choose a style and mood, and TuneCraft creates two takes for you to explore. Try another style, bring back your latest song, or browse the songs in your connected TuneCraft library. In ChatGPT, listen with the turntable player and switch between Take A and Take B. In Codex, get song information and links to listen on the TuneCraft website.

Sign in to your TuneCraft account to create and access your songs. Generated song pages are public and show the creator's display name. Song audio is normally available for three days; download the takes you want to keep from the website. TuneCraft cannot delete songs through the plugin. Requests to imitate real artists, reuse copyrighted lyrics, or include sexually explicit content are not supported.
